Home / Transparency / Procurement

Bids and awards, as published.

The municipality separates invitations to bid from bid results. When checked, the invitation page said there were no projects available for bidding, while the results page listed eleven entries under the 2026 filter.

This guide does not host bid documents or infer award values from a title.

On this page InvitationsBid resultsLimits of the record

No projects available for bidding

That is the message shown on the official Invitation to Bid page when checked. It is a snapshot of that page, not a statement that the municipality never procures.

The results page offers 2026 and 2025 filters. These eleven entries are the ones shown under the 2026 filter when checked.

What is not visible

The extracted results text does not show an ABC, contract price, Notice of Award date, or supplier. Titles and processing status are the only fields repeated here.
